name: Philippines
startIntroPart1: Greetings, José Rizal. You awakened the Filipino people's consciousness through your writings, courage, and unwavering love for your homeland. Your ideas helped inspire a nation that would one day seek its freedom.
startIntroPart2: The Filipino people look toward you once more. Unite the archipelago, cultivate knowledge, strengthen the nation's institutions, and establish a country capable of standing among the world's great civilizations. Through education, scientific progress, commerce, and national unity, your vision of a prosperous Philippines may finally become reality. Will you guide your people toward greatness?
declaringWar: Our nation will not surrender its dignity. We shall defend our homeland!
attacked: You mistake our peaceful intentions for weakness. We shall stand firm!
defeated: A nation may fall, but the ideals of its people shall endure.
introduction: Welcome to the Philippine Nation. I am José Rizal.
neutralHello: Greetings. May knowledge and understanding guide our dealings.
hateHello: Your intentions toward our nation are becoming increasingly clear.
tradeRequest: Let us consider an agreement that benefits both our peoples.
